measurement.clock: Local requests and spans use CLOCK_MONOTONIC. Worker ranges match requests by file byte offsets. A request window can include client tokenization.
measurement.exclusive: Parent duration minus the union of direct child intervals, summed per traced thread. Graph/copy APIs can enqueue asynchronous work.
measurement.phase: Outermost target/model process is classified by position relative to prompt length, with explicit draft/accept decode phases. Other roots use client first-token time.
measurement.rpc_bytes: Outermost transfer bytes are logical. Leaf RPC GET/SET are observed payload sizes and can include both legs of a relayed tensor. Packet/framing bytes and unobserved calls are excluded.
measurement.rpc_time: Transfer API durations include queueing or GPU synchronization and can overlap other groups. RPC wait and graph submission are reported separately.
measurement.worker_gets: Per-node GET calls match by request byte range, order, tensor name and size. Worker sync and D2H are subtracted from the controller API duration. Residual includes transport, scheduling, and host work, and preceding worker graph submit can overlap it.
